input.free_text_description: The system operates in the microservices infrastructure, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include api user, feign api user, feign user. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage api user operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage feign api user operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage feign user operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
